title: Access from Tablets, Phones & Other Computers
subtitle: No install needed — just a browser. Plus a one-tap “app” icon for tablets.
in_this_chapter: Open OpenTrack in any browser on the network
Add it to a tablet's home screen as an installable web app
Where the browser fits (Linux, Raspberry Pi, phones)

blocks.p: Any device on the same network — an iPad, an Android tablet, a phone, a Linux laptop, a Raspberry Pi — can use OpenTrack with **no install at all**. Just open a browser and go to the **exact same web address the setup script printed** — the one you used to register on the server. It looks like this (your number will be different):

callout.label: USE YOUR SERVER'S REAL NUMBER
callout.text: `192.168.1.50` above is just an example. Type **your** server's number (the one the setup script printed), not this one. Same address on every device.

blocks.p: Sign in with your account. That's it. This is the universal way in, and it's the *only* option on devices that can't run the native desktop app (Linux, Raspberry Pi, phones, tablets).

blocks.h1: Add it to a tablet's home screen

blocks.p: OpenTrack is a **Progressive Web App (PWA)**, so a tablet can pin it to the home screen and open it like a real app — full screen, its own icon, and it even keeps working through brief network drops for checklists.

steps: **iPad (Safari):** open the URL, tap the **Share** button, then **Add to Home Screen**.
**Android (Chrome):** open the URL, tap the **⋮** menu, then **Install app** / **Add to Home screen**.
Launch it from the new icon — it opens full-screen, like an installed app.

callout.label: GREAT FOR RUNNING A CHECKLIST
callout.text: The tablet PWA is ideal for walking a project's bug-hunt checklist — you can check items off even if the Wi-Fi hiccups, and it syncs when you're back online.
